title: Sentinel detection event (internal)
description: One line of a detections JSONL file consumed by `sentinel run --detections`. This is Sentinel's own internal format. It is NOT PipeGen's output format: a converter from genuine PipeGen JSON metadata to this schema must be written once a real PipeGen output sample is available. Each record describes all detections for one frame of one stream.

stream_id.description: Must match the Sentinel stream_id to be used.

source.description: Producer of the detections, e.g. the name of the pipeline that ran the model.

frame_index.description: 0-based index of the decoded frame in the source video. Preferred association key.

timestamp_s.description: Stream time of the frame in seconds. Used when frame_index is absent; matched to the nearest frame within a tolerance.

detections.description: All detections for this frame. An empty array means the detector ran and found nothing.

bbox.description: [x, y, width, height] in source-frame pixels; width and height > 0.
